name: SlugAudit MCP
description: Pre-parsed, searchable evidence about a codebase — symbols, imports, dependency edges, source spans — re-verified against disk before every call, so the AI queries a SQLite database instead of reading hundreds of flat files. Rust is the only tested language; other languages use grammars downloaded on first use and are flagged as untested.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Arbitrary read-only SQL against the project's SQLite index. Joins, CTEs, the lot. Paged, with step and time budgets.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Snapshot of the current revision: file and language counts, skipped files, import resolution, and notices for untested languages.

tools.name: structure
tools.description: Tree-sitter structural pattern matching (single-file or multi-file AST search with lean snippets). Rust is tested; other languages are best-effort and flagged in `notices`.

tools.name: leads
tools.description: Counts and paged file/line rows for mechanical observations — call-site shapes (unwrap/expect/panic/todo/assert), diagnostics, TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX comment markers, and credential-shaped paths. Unranked: no severity, no verdict.

tools.name: mechanic
tools.description: Register, remove, or list your own mechanics (Tree-sitter call or structure patterns) that `leads` then counts like a built-in.

tools.name: finding
tools.description: Records an audit finding against the evidence, bound to the file's current hash. It lasts until the server exits.

tools.name: finding_read
tools.description: Reads the findings recorded in this session, each current or stale against the file's present hash. A restart begins with none.

tools.name: finding_clear
tools.description: Deletes every finding recorded in this session for a project and reports how many were removed.

tools.name: project_control
tools.description: Enable or disable a project — creates the .planning/slugaudit directory and runs the first import, or deletes that directory.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Server and database state: phase, last-sync timestamp, tool-call counters. Never syncs.
